description: Prospective, observed-position SkillCorner measurement state sampled at 5 Hz.

entity_schema.ball: Null when source ball_data is null; otherwise x_m, y_m and source is_detected are preserved. No inferred ball position.
entity_schema.match: match_id is the pinned provider match ID; home_team_id and away_team_id are pinned provider team IDs.
entity_schema.period: Source period 1 or 2, or null when the source has no period label.
entity_schema.player: Only players listed in this source frame are emitted, sorted by player_id. player_id is match-scoped; team_id and home/away group come from this match's roster id/team_id mapping.
entity_schema.possession: Null remains null; otherwise preserve source group and player_id, including a null player_id.
entity_schema.sample: source_frame is the provider video frame; canonical_sample_index is source_frame // 2; timestamp_deciseconds is the source match clock converted exactly to integer deciseconds or null.
entity_schema.team_orientation: Keep provider home/away group and physical coordinates; do not rotate or attack-direction-normalize.

excluded: tracking.ball_data.z (the pinned source documentation does not establish its unit/reference)
dynamic_events.csv and phases_of_play.csv, including all event/phase labels
all source fields not listed as canonical, auxiliary, or provenance-only
provenance_only: match.match_periods boundary metadata (not used to sample or select benchmark windows)
source file paths and immutable byte identities bound by the source release
retained_auxiliary_context: match.players[].id/team_id roster crosswalk used to assign canonical team/group

missing_values.absent_player: Remain absent from that sample; do not pad from the roster or forward-fill.
missing_values.ball: Source null remains JSON null; an object with null coordinates remains an object with null coordinates.
missing_values.coordinates: Explicit source null is preserved component-wise; NaN and infinity are rejected.
missing_values.possession: Source null remains JSON null; null player_id remains null.
missing_values.source_extrapolation: Preserve is_detected=false with the provider x/y values; do not filter or relabel it.

no_future_leakage.current_sample_only: Every emitted positional, detection, ball, and possession value comes from that same retained source frame; static match metadata supplies only IDs and pitch dimensions.
forbidden: event/phase labels attached to tracking samples
future targets, opponent positions, or ball context
no_future_leakage.scope: Future conditional context and benchmark information boundaries are downstream decisions.

numeric_representation.coordinates_and_pitch_dimensions: Python binary64 floats in meters, converted from source JSON numbers without rounding or normalization; finite values only, explicit null allowed where the source is null.
numeric_representation.identifiers_and_indices: Nonnegative/positive provider identifiers and frame indices remain JSON integers; booleans are not accepted as integers.
numeric_representation.timestamp: Parse HH:MM:SS.cc source strings to integer deciseconds; accept only source 100 ms ticks; preserve null as null.
numeric_representation.z_coordinate: Excluded because the pinned source documentation does not define its unit/reference.

serialization.encoding: UTF-8 without BOM or trailing newline.
serialization.hash: SHA-256 over UTF-8 canonical JSON of scientific_state with sorted keys and compact separators; descriptive manifest fields are excluded.
serialization.json: Python JSON serialization with recursively sorted object keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=false, allow_nan=false; players sorted by player_id; binary64 floats use Python's shortest round-trip decimal representation.

spatial_semantics.pitch_dimensions: preserve match-specific pitch_length and pitch_width as metadata in meters
spatial_semantics.positive_axis_signs: not specified by the pinned source documentation; preserve provider values unchanged

temporal_sampling.canonical_sample_index: source_frame // 2, on the global provider video-frame index
temporal_sampling.duplicate_or_non_monotonic_frames: fail; source frame numbers must increase strictly across the match
temporal_sampling.frame_timestamp_consistency: Within consecutive source rows with the same non-null period and non-null timestamps, timestamp_deciseconds delta must equal source_frame delta (one decisecond per 10 Hz source frame).
temporal_sampling.missing_source_frames: Emit no synthetic sample; retain only observed even-numbered frames, leaving canonical_sample_index gaps where frames are absent.
temporal_sampling.parity_anchor: absolute source frame number; retain source_frame % 2 == 0. Parity does not restart at a period boundary.
temporal_sampling.period_boundary: Copy the source period. The global source frame and canonical index do not reset; timestamp continuity validation restarts at a period change.
temporal_sampling.timestamp: Copy the corresponding source row's match-clock time exactly as integer deciseconds; do not derive time from a neighboring sample.
temporal_sampling.transform: Direct selection of the source observation on even frames; no interpolation, smoothing, or averaging.
